caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate bowl with a wide brim and a pedestal base, shown against a neutral, light tan background. The bowl is rendered in shades of white, gray, and pale peach, with gold trim around the rim, the base, and as a decorative leaf motif encircling both the upper edge and the foot of the bowl. On the bowl's outer surface, there is an intricate painted scene in vivid colors, dominated by blue, green, and tan hues. The scene shows a waterfront with a prominent building or fortification in tan with green roofs and several attached smaller structures, all situated on a pier extending into a blue body of water. Many small boats and ships are visible in the water, and there are people walking along the edge of the pier and nearby fence. An American flag is flying atop the central building. The background of the painting on the bowl includes a cloudy sky in shades of blue and gray, as well as sailboats and faint landforms across the water. At the bottom left of the drawing, there is a small yellow ruler indicating scale. The artist's signature "chas. Cilsen" appears in the lower right corner of the composition.
title: Punch Bowl
